name: comp-208
title: Select With Error State
blurb: Select showing error state with validation message.
description: Select with aria-invalid attribute and error message below using aria-live='polite' role='alert' to announce validation errors to screen readers.
use_when: You need to show form validation errors for a select field.
avoid_when: For valid fields; only use in error scenarios.
a11y: aria-invalid marks invalid state. Error message is alert live region for screen readers.
